description: Use this to carry on a bid draft Winquill started with start_bid_draft: give it the buyer's questions it asked for, the team's answers to the questions Winquill asked, or the go-ahead to draft now with what it has (Winquill marks the gaps [TO CONFIRM]). Drafting starts once Winquill's questions are answered, or when draft_now is true. Pass each answer with the question's number or words. Needs a Winquill account. Do not use for a new bid (use start_bid_draft).

answers.description: The team's answers to Winquill's questions.

answer.description: The team's answer, in their words.

question.description: The question Winquill asked, by its number such as "2", or its words.

draft_id.description: The draft's ID, from start_bid_draft. Or give the tender's reference instead, or neither for the workspace's latest draft.

draft_now.description: true to start drafting now, with any of Winquill's questions unanswered.

notes.description: Anything else the team wants Winquill to use in the bid.

questions_text.description: The buyer's questions, when Winquill asked for them.

tender_reference.description: The notice ID, procurement identifier, solicitation number or the buyer's own reference, e.g. "012345-2026" on Find a Tender, "WS4851234567" on CanadaBuys or "140D0427Q0879" on SAM.gov.

workspace.description: The Winquill workspace to use, by name, when the user is in more than one, e.g. "Northbridge Services".

name: continue_bid_draft

step.description: questions, team, plan, write, mark, revise or ready; stopped when drafting stopped.

stepsDone.description: Steps done of steps: all of them once it's ready.

title: Carry on Winquill's bid draft
